copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: Claude 会在 NanoClaw 内复制并注册 Google Chat 适配器,安装固定版本的依赖,执行构建和一条注册测试。之后还需你按提示在 Google Cloud 配好凭据并开放公网地址,消息才能真正到达。
howto.when: 当你说要给 NanoClaw 加上 Google Chat、想对接 Google Chat 消息,或在 /setup 中配置频道时,Claude 会开始执行添加流程。

say.text: 帮 NanoClaw 加上 Google Chat 频道
给 NanoClaw 接入 Google Chat 消息
say.note: 会提示你粘贴服务账号 JSON,并开放公网地址。

say.text: 继续 /setup,把 Google Chat 配上去
say.note: 用于在安装流程中继续添加该频道。

howto.what_en: Claude copies and registers the Google Chat adapter inside NanoClaw, installs the pinned dependency, builds, and runs one registration test. You still must complete the Google Cloud credential setup and expose a public URL before messages arrive.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add Google Chat to NanoClaw, connect Google Chat messages, or reach the channel configuration step during /setup.

say_en.text: Add a Google Chat channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude copies, registers, installs, then builds.

say_en.text: Connect Google Chat messages to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Finish Google Cloud credential setup and expose the URL.
Continues the setup flow with this channel.
